test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.**

Shamim have not / attended school / for four days now.
solution:
The erroneous part is '**Shamim have not**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, '**Shamim has not**' should be used instead of '**Shamim have not**'.
 
• In the given sentence '**Shamim**' is a** singular noun.**
 
• Hence, it should be followed by **a singular helping verb** that is '**has**'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__ *****Shamim has not **attended school for four days now.*
